units.name: hydrogen_feed_compressor
units.purpose: Compress purchased hydrogen from battery-limit pressure to synthesis-loop pressure

units.name: nitrogen_feed_compressor
units.purpose: Compress purchased nitrogen from battery-limit pressure to synthesis-loop pressure

units.name: synthesis_gas_mixer
units.purpose: Combine stoichiometric fresh feeds with unreacted recycle gas

units.name: feed_effluent_exchanger
units.purpose: Recover converter-effluent sensible heat to preheat synthesis-loop feed

units.name: ammonia_converter
units.purpose: Catalytically convert nitrogen and hydrogen to ammonia in an equilibrium-limited multibed converter

units.name: waste_heat_boiler
units.purpose: Remove exothermic reaction heat and recover it as useful steam-equivalent heat

units.name: final_product_cooler
units.purpose: Cool synthesis gas sufficiently to condense ammonia for phase separation

units.name: ammonia_knockout
units.purpose: Separate condensed liquid ammonia from unreacted hydrogen and nitrogen

units.name: purge_splitter
units.purpose: Remove a small purge to prevent accumulation of feed impurities and route the remainder to recycle

units.name: recycle_compressor
units.purpose: Restore recycle-gas pressure losses before remixing with fresh synthesis gas

units.name: product_and_offsites
units.purpose: Provide synthesis-loop utility distribution, controls, storage allowance, and product battery-limit handling

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: Ammonia-synthesis catalysts are replaced during planned turnarounds; no continuous in-situ regeneration unit is justified inside this battery limit.

product_compression.excluded: Condensed ammonia leaves at adequate pressure and is let down to the specified 20 bar product state, so no product compressor is required.

diagram: H2 -> hydrogen_feed_compressor --\n                                  > synthesis_gas_mixer -> feed_effluent_exchanger -> ammonia_converter -> waste_heat_boiler -> feed_effluent_exchanger -> final_product_cooler -> ammonia_knockout -> liquid NH3 -> product_and_offsites -> product\nN2 -> nitrogen_feed_compressor --/                                                                                                                         \-> gas -> purge_splitter -> purge + recycle_compressor --recycle--> mixer
